source_title: Destiny 2 Officially Bringing Menagerie Back With New Rewards
source_excerpt:
Bungie shared an official update on Destiny 2 , the process of unvaulting its content, and future updates, stating that the Menagerie will come back. It has been a wild ride in the last year for Bungie's iconic looter-shooter, with Renegades not bringing back as many players as it needed, a few delays and communication hiccups, and then the announcement that the game would end all live-service support in June after a final update. Monument of Triumph was a major release for Destiny 2 , and now Bungie is resurrecting the game.
Not only that, but Bungie is also promising to keep updating Marathon with significant improvements, and the upcoming Season 3 update seems to be doing exactly that. On top of it, new leaks suggest that Bungie could make Star Wars Battlefront 3 for Disney , taking on the mantle from DICE. This is speculation at this point, and while Bungie didn't confirm that this is happening, those who reached out for comments were not told that the rumors are fake. Some fans are hoping for this to be true, as Bungie's gunplay is great, and it could fit a new Star Wars Battlefront game perfectly, if Destiny 2 's Renegades expansion is any indication.
Bungie Shares Official Timeline For Destiny 2 Updates, Confirms Menagerie's Return

Bungie's Josh Deane shared a heartfelt post and update on the current state of Destiny 2 plans, including a timeline of what is going to happen and going over the content that is being brought back. The first batch of content unvaulting in Destiny 2 will include old campaigns (Red War, Curse of Osiris, Warmind, and Forsaken), Strikes, Raid Lairs, and full Raids from the aforementioned releases, and the Menagerie activity with reprised rewards. Currently, Bungie's plans are in pre-production, according to the new official timeline, and production will begin in February 2027. The release date is yet to be disclosed, but Bungie promises that fans won't be empty-handed for long. In fact, a new official Destiny 2 update like Monument of Triumph is coming in February 2027 , as hinted at by the new Bungie Community Update post.

Destiny 2 's Leviathan Raid is officially coming back with the update, and so are the other Leviathan Lairs, making the return of Menagerie the next logical step for Bungie. This is possibly the single most beloved activity ever added to the game, and it's not only coming back first thing when Bungie is ready, but it's also getting a loot refresh. This means that Menagerie will come with multiple Tier 5-adjusted weapons and a brand-new armor set. The loot included in the original Menagerie includes:
Weapons : Austringer, Beloved, CALUS Mini-Tool, Drang, Fixed Odds, Imperial Decree, and The Epicurean
Armor : Opulent Helm, Opulent Gauntlets, Opulent Chest, Opulent Legs, and Opulent Class Item
Since the new armor set bonuses in Destiny 2 's Monument of Triumph were some of the best and most well-received in the game, a new set bonus for Opulent armor from the most beloved activity in the game could generate a lot of hype. Whether Bungie delivers remains to be seen, but promises have been made.
Further testament to Bungie's promises is another update that may have flown under the radar. In fact, Bungie is hiring again for Destiny 2 , which is a great sign in and of itself.
